name: Hoodrich
notes: hoodrich.com is NOT the brand: it belongs to Hood-Rich Architecture, Springfield MO. The official store is hoodrichuk.com ('Hoodrich Official Store | From Nothing To Something'; Hoodrich Ltd trademark). Any stored hoodrich.com URL is a wrong record.

Our Story: founded 2014 by Jay Williams; HQ opened in Birmingham's Jewellery Quarter in 2023; 'roots in music and street culture'; logo alt text 'Hoodrich Streetwear Logo'. Hoodrich Ltd is the trademark holder; no parent company is named.
Prices are null. The store showed GBP only (£35–£130 across 56 items) and labelled every price 'Sale price', so regular and sale prices can't be told apart. No USD shown; nothing converted.
